title: 资源托举为什么会变成路径控制
central_argument: Support may become path control when concentrated resources are conditioned on a prescribed route, the provider controls the definition of success and refusal becomes costly; none of these conditions alone licenses a universal diagnosis.
counterexamples_explicit: Direct coercion as a distinct boundary
An informed recipient choosing the route after genuine alternatives
claim_ceiling: A repository-originated candidate model and research problem only; no universal causal law, measured prevalence, diagnosis, external validation or epistemic acceptance.
